summary: FINAL pre-launch regression (iter 9) — GREEN. Backend: 14/14 in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py, 23.7s (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter9_results.xml). Total image generations for the entire run: EXACTLY 2 (only in TestAssetVersions), confirmed via /usage returning {generations_used: 2, generations_limit: 9} on the throwaway account. Frontend (mobile 375x667, Playwright, demo login demo@creatorforge.app/creator123): every requested flow verified. Coverage: A) Auth — demo login+register+/auth/me OK; /usage /projects /brand-kits /brand-memory /analytics all require auth (401 unauth) and return their expected shapes (usage: {plan, generations_used, generations_limit, premium_until,...}; brand-memory: {enabled,tone,keywords,colors}; projects: {projects:[]}; brand-kits: {brand_kits:[]}; analytics: dict payload). B) IAP — GET /payments/iap/products returns pro.monthly ($14.99, plan=monthly) and pro.yearly ($149, plan=yearly). POST /payments/iap/verify: no-auth→401, unknown product→400, ios missing receipt→400, ios dummy receipt→503 (apple_not_configured), android missing token→400. C) Gallery/trending — GET /api/gallery (no auth) returns {items, trending}; every gallery/trending item exposes exactly {id, name, colors, fonts, style_rules, logo, alias, remix_count, published_at} — NO user_id, NO email (asserted the fresh registrant's email string is absent from the serialized item). Trending row correctly contains only kits with remix_count>=1 and is sorted DESC (verified with two seeded kits getting 2 and 1 remixes respectively). Report flow: 3 reports auto-unpublish the kit (hidden:false → false → true), the kit vanishes from /gallery, and a 4th report returns 404. Publish/unpublish idempotent. Non-owner publish → 404 (verified in iter8; not re-run here). D) Asset versions — throwaway user created project + brand kit (auto_generate:false), then generate ONE asset (image gen #1: 200, asset returned with image_b64 + streak_event=dict|None), GET /versions returns {asset_id, current, versions:[]} (empty on first gen). Regenerate (image gen #2: 200, distinct image_b64), versions list grows to exactly 1 with the previous image, streak_event shape validated. Revert (NO gen) restores previous image as current and swaps the outgoing regen into history — versions still length 1, and the reverted version's id no longer appears in the versions list (fresh uuid for the swapped-in entry). FRONTEND: Login via use-demo-button + auth-submit-button works, welcome-explore-button dismisses the tour, /dashboard renders smart-nudge-card + quick-start tiles (quick-ai-agent, quick-new-idea, quick-start-branding, quick-templates, quick-insights, quick-surprises) + dashboard-plan-badge + hero-upgrade-button + 4 dash-project-<id> tiles (streak & milestones surfaced visually per screenshot but no dedicated testIDs — matches prior iterations). /incubator lists 5 project-card-<id> tiles + filter-{all,ideas,branding,complete} + project-search-input + fab-new-idea; offline-banner correctly NOT rendered (online). /studio shows 4 brand-kit-<id> tiles, 2 asset-tile-<id>, tool-community-gallery + tool-palette-generator + tool-templates, download-all-button, new-brand-kit-button. tool-community-gallery navigation to /gallery works; /gallery renders gallery-back + trending-<id> row (2 trending kits seeded from backend tests) + gallery-item-<id> tiles with remix-<id> + report-<id> buttons. Publish flow on a demo brand-kit: publish-toggle click flipped state (screenshot captured 'Removed from gallery' toast on the second toggle after publishing), and API GET /gallery immediately returned the kit under alias='A CreatorForge maker' with no email string in the item; toggling again removed it — round-trip verified. kit-share-story icon on the brand-kit header navigates to /story/<kit_id>?title=<name>. Creation Story: story-back + story-share-button present; before-after-toggle + before-block CORRECTLY ABSENT on this kit because it has no project_id linkage (matches spec: 'On a kit without project, toggle absent'). Note: the toggle-PRESENT scenario was fully verified in iter8 via a fresh project+kit under the demo account; not re-verified here to avoid extra image gens (spec-compliant). /paywall renders subscribe-button + plan-monthly + plan-yearly + paywall-close + paywall-restore-button (web Stripe path — no expo-iap crash on web). /asset/[id] mounts cleanly with asset-back + asset-export + asset-tweak-input + asset-regenerate — regenerate NOT tapped (paid). Deprecated packages: NONE new. RN-web warnings: only the acknowledged carry-over shadow* + pointerEvents deprecation warnings — cosmetic on web, no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1185-1206 verify_iap correctly gates unknown product (400), missing receipt/token per platform (400), invalid platform (400), unconfigured store creds (503 via *_not_configured), and successful path is idempotent via transaction_id upsert on db.iap_transactions.
server.py:755-765 /gallery returns two lists in one call; trending is a second Mongo query filtered on remix_count>=1 and sorted -1 — clean, cheap, and no PII path through public_gallery_kit().

server.py:907-953 regenerate_asset correctly pushes the outgoing image into a most-recent-first versions array (capped by MAX_ASSET_VERSIONS), gates behind check_and_count_generation (with refund on failure), returns streak_event + newly_unlocked + surprise for the hooked-model flywheel. Good.
server.py:956-986 revert_asset does NOT consume a generation, correctly swaps the current into history and the target out — versions stay bounded by MAX_ASSET_VERSIONS.
server.py:1110-1117 iap_products is public (no auth) and returns only static plan metadata — appropriate for the store-side product fetch on client init.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested UI flow verified (dashboard, incubator online-only banner, studio 3 tools, /gallery items+trending, publish-toggle publish→appear-anonymously→unpublish, kit-share-story→/story mount with story-back+story-share-button+correctly-absent before-after-toggle on unlinked kit, /paywall subscribe-button, /asset/[id] 4 testIDs)
